g.text: Sequence Diagram - WEB03 Role-Based Menu (menu built from the current roles after login or page reload)
Starts after a successful local (AA01) or Google (AA02) login, or when the SPA is
(re)loaded and a token is stored (AA04). Roles are NEVER decoded from the JWT and
NEVER chosen by the user: the only source is GET /api/v1/auth/me (AA03).
While roles are not confirmed, only PUBLIC sections are shown (fail closed).
opens / reloads the SPA (or login succeeded)
/auth/me answers are mapped by AuthProvider directly (table A, 3.4):
the global 401/403 handler is NOT invoked, so no branch below
can start another /auth/me request (BR 13). Every error branch ends here.
[B1) Token invalid / user deleted (401) or roles not confirmable (5xx, network error)]
[B2) Account inactive or without any role (403, AA03)]
"No active role is assigned to this account", status: 403 } }
Example [CUSTOMER, MANAGER] = UNION of both roles:
Catalogue, Privacy notice, My privacy & consents,
allergens, pizza sizes, component types, predefined
